rules.summary: A lawyer shall not make a false or misleading communication about the lawyer or the lawyer services.
A specialist claim requires qualifying certification and clear identification of the certifying organization.
A Rule 7.1 communication must include name and contact information of at least one lawyer or law firm responsible for its content.
Solicitation is a lawyer-initiated communication directed to a specific person known or reasonably known to need legal services in a particular matter and offering legal services for that matter.
Live person-to-person solicitation for pecuniary gain is prohibited except for specified relationships.
Solicitation is prohibited after a target indicates a desire not to be solicited and when it involves coercion, duress or harassment.

supersessionNote: This delta replaces pre39 NY placeholder status for these mapped current provisions only; it does not claim complete New York or nationwide advertising/solicitation compliance.
